title: Answer: experience is derived, feelings with algorithmic reasons in a system of matter

statements.text: Matter As Machine gives no separate account of consciousness, and reads feelings as parts of an algorithm. People consist of matter, matter executes an algorithm, so people execute algorithms too. Happiness, eureka moments, depression, obsessions and changing goals may all have algorithmic reasons, and instincts generate the desires that feel like a person's own. Experience is in this reading derived, a high-level effect of execution, and the site does not say why execution is felt.
